sources.games: 542 league games since 7.40 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 51.1%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py legion_commander.
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 104 (Overwhelming Odds, Press the Attack, Moment of Courage, Duel), 7.41f.

rules.name: Black King Bar
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Black King Bar: Avatar applies a basic dispel, 60% magic resistance and makes negative effects of enemy spells do nothing for 9/8/7 s. It is in her build (50% of the won games, ~26 min); Pipe of Insight is not. Duel holds the target 4-5 s: nothing of theirs may stop her during it.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, so their spells cannot break your Duel
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, щоб їхні здібності не зірвали ваш Duel

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: bracer 76% (2), magic_wand 72% (4), phase_boots 95% (7), blade_mail 97% (12), ultimate_scepter 39% (25), aghanims_shard 35% (26), black_king_bar 50% (26), buckler 21% (32).
